title: A girl on a bicycle, from the taxi between the base and Saigon
description: A girl of perhaps ten in light polka-dot pyjama-style clothes pedals an adult bicycle straight at the camera down a dirt street, concentrating hard; behind her, blurred, a two-storey building carries two Coca-Cola signs above green roller shutters. "Location is between Ton Suhn Nhut and Saigon. I was in a Taxi cab when taking the photo. The photo is a random person and random shot."
researchNotes: Larry's caption of 2026-09-05 (giscus-vn-0062-c18307725.json). He places it on the road between the base and the city rather than in either, so no place is entered. It belongs with the taxi frames — VN-0064 and VN-0073 on the river, VN-0067 at the airport end of the base — that together describe the ride he took with the driver he called VC Charlie.
